description: The field contract for the semantics register: which documents exist, what each must carry, which keys are refused outright, and the invariants that hold ACROSS documents. bin/fm-semantics.sh is the only interpreter of this directory; its header and --help own the exact commands and flags.
why: Each document below already states its own internal invariants. This file owns the ones no single document can see - that a reason namespace a law names exists, that a projection is emitted from a declared owner, that no document has quietly acquired a runtime.

the_boundary_this_register_may_never_cro.may: describe semantics, legal successors, source mappings, compatibility, identity namespaces, reason namespaces, seam contracts and versions
the_boundary_this_register_may_never_cro.may_not: hold current task state, scheduling, queues, orchestration, current decisions, a runtime, a watcher, a database, an event bus or a hook bus
the_boundary_this_register_may_never_cro.why: bin/fm-decision-surface.sh is this fleet resolved operational surface and answers what a task is doing. The moment this register answers that, the fleet has two answers to one question and both are credited with the same sentence. The refused_keys list below is the mechanical form of this boundary: an entry carrying one is refused outright rather than having the key ignored, because an ignored field still reads to a human as the answer.

laws.role: the five laws, three gate-placement predicates, horizon predicate, lifecycle strategy and adoption prerequisites

state-families.role: work families, legal successors, terminal reasons, verdict vocabularies and every source mapping

reasons.role: the six reason namespaces and their codes

identity.role: identity namespaces, the canonical subject record, and cross-namespace edges

seams.role: the seam row contract, seam states, protocol law and declared protocols

inheritance-manifest-schema.role: the field contract for one inheritance manifest

census.role: the migration source of truth; explicitly NOT an owner

required_in_every_document.document: must equal the key naming it in documents above
required_in_every_document.description: one paragraph: what this document owns
required_in_every_document.authority: authoritative, diagnostic, or an object mapping sections to one of those - what this document output may currently be used for
required_in_every_document.invariants: the checks this document own interpreter enforces, stated as name: meaning

refused_keys_why: Every one of these names a thing this register may not become. They are refused OUTRIGHT rather than ignored, following the mechanism commitments/schema.json already uses, because an ignored field still reads to a human as the answer. The list is deliberately about shape rather than content: it cannot stop a bad description, and it can stop the register from growing a second decision surface one key at a time.

authority_values.authoritative: a consumer may rely on this as the current fact
authority_values.diagnostic: a consumer may read this and may not rely on it. A diagnostic output must SAY SO in its own text rather than relying on a reader to remember. Everything defined new on the branch that introduced this register is diagnostic until the adoption prerequisites in semantics/laws.json pass for it.

generated_projections.rule: A generated file declares its generator and its owner set in its own bytes, and is reproducible byte-for-byte from the owners. A hand edit is DRIFT and refuses.

outputs.consumers: any owner that needs the whole contract as data
an existing shell owner that needs the vocabulary without a JSON parse

generated_projections.no_current_state: A projection carries vocabulary, legality, mappings and versions. It carries no task, no queue and no decision, and the refused_keys rule applies to a projection exactly as it applies to an owner.

cross_document_invariants: every_document_present: every path in documents must exist and be readable JSON
schema_version_agrees: every document semantics_schema_version must equal this file version
document_key_agrees: every document self-declared document name must equal its key here
law_reason_namespaces_exist: every reason_namespace a law names must be declared in reasons
law_validator_names_exist: every non-null validator a law names must be one of the four declared validators
census_rows_name_real_owners: every census row naming a manifest must name one that exists under semantics/manifests/
census_introduces_no_vocabulary: no census row may declare a vocabulary member absent from the owner documents
no_refused_key_anywhere: no document, manifest or projection may carry a refused key at any depth
projection_declares_generator: every generated output must carry a generated block naming its generator and the owner documents it was compiled from
validators_why_four: One per law that is decidable from declarations. The Seam Contract law deliberately has none, because a seam state is an OBSERVATION of a crossing made by the seam owner and is not decidable from a file. A fifth validator returning a seam verdict from declarations would grade the declaration and be credited to the crossing - the exact wrong-subject failure this substrate exists to refuse.
